conventions.dims_m: [width X, depth Y, height Z] in metres as measured after Blender 4.5 glTF import / .blend append (Z up).
conventions.front: ABO GLBs: front faces -Y in Blender (= glTF +Z); verified with 3/4 renders of every downloaded model.
conventions.tris: triangle count of the evaluated meshes.
conventions.mb: file size on disk (GLB, or whole Poly Haven model folder with 2k textures).
conventions.pick_lists: cushions, decor, bath_accessories use lists for pick/runner_up (sets of items).
conventions.material_maps: tex/<name>/Diffuse.jpg (sRGB), Rough.jpg, nor_gl.jpg (OpenGL), arm.jpg (AO/rough/metal) when AO exists, disp.jpg (height, extra). Tile sizes added to tex/dims.json.
conventions.licenses: Only CC0 (Poly Haven, ambientCG) and CC BY 4.0 (ABO, credit "Amazon.com") assets. CC BY items must be credited on the site (credits page/footer) with a link to the license and a note that they were modified.
